Middlesex County, Virginia Tax Sales: Essential Information

Interested in participating in tax sales in Middlesex County, Virginia? This guide provides a clear overview to help you navigate the process effectively.​

Understanding Tax Sales in Middlesex County

Middlesex County conducts tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These auctions offer opportunities for individuals to purchase properties with delinquent taxes.​

Key Details About Middlesex County Tax Sales

  • Scheduling: Tax sales occur as needed, without a fixed annual date.​
  • Auction Time: Auctions typically begin at 11:00 AM Eastern Time. Always verify the exact time in the official auction announcement.​
  • Registration Requirements: Participants must register before bidding. Registration periods vary for each sale, so consult the specific auction notice for deadlines.​
  • Auction Location: Sales are held at the Historic Courthouse Board Room, 865 General Puller Highway, Saluda, VA 23149. Some auctions may also offer online bidding options.​
  • Redemption Period: Property owners can redeem their property by paying all outstanding taxes, penalties, interest, and costs at any time before the auction.​
  • Bidding Process:
    • Properties are sold to the highest bidder.​
    • A deposit of 25% of the purchase price or $1,000 (whichever is higher), plus a 10% buyer’s premium (minimum $150), is required.​
    • Full payment must be made within seven days following the auction closing.​TACS
    • Payments must be in certified funds, cashier’s check, money order, or wire transfer.​TACS
    • Properties are sold “as-is,” so thorough research before bidding is essential.​
